a.lede: TikTok has released a standalone app for TikTok Shop in a few countries, as spotted by social media consultant Matt Navarra. According to its App Store listing, the TikTok Shop app offers: - Personalized picks inspired by your interests - LIVE streams & short videos to see products in action - App-only deals, free shipping […]
a.title: TikTok launched a dedicated TikTok Shop app

b.lede: The app will offer personalized product recommendations, shopping through livestreams and short-form videos, app-exclusive deals, in-app checkout, order tracking, and customer support.
b.title: TikTok quietly launches a stand-alone TikTok Shop app
